chunks: And Ḥammād narrated from al-Ḥalabī, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
He was asked about a man whom death approaches and he divorces his wife—whether his divorce is valid. He said: "Yes, and she inherits from him; but if she dies, he does not inherit from her."

key_terms.الْمَوْتُ: death, here meaning the onset of a fatal condition
key_terms.طَلَاقُهُ: his divorce, meaning the legal validity of the divorce pronouncement
key_terms.لَمْ يَرِثْهَا: he does not inherit from her

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on divorce and inheritance if a man divorces his wife during his final illness?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about a man who divorces his wife while in the state of terminal illness. The divorce is deemed valid, yet the wife still inherits from him, while he does not inherit from her if she dies, indicating a specific fiqh ruling concerning divorce during fatal illness and mutual inheritance.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.5669 - Hammad narrated from Al-Halabi, from Abu Abdullah (as), who was asked about a man who is on his deathbed and divorces his wife - whether his divorce is valid.
Imam (as) said: "Yes, it is valid, and she will inherit from him. However, if she dies, he does not inherit from her."
